verdicts.reason: A: the oversized logo's 'MONOGRAPH' wordmark runs into the edge of the white panel. The 'Plan a Visit' CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill jammed against the bottom edge, and the 'NOW OPEN' eyebrow now sits after the CTA instead of above the headline. B is worse on reading order: the CTA sits above the headline and 'NOW OPEN' falls to the bottom. Its 'MONOGRAPH' wordmark also spills off the photo panel into the white, and the body line runs right up against the logo panel. A at least keeps headline, then body, then action.
